evidence: Matches the P2P label and changes connection management in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
rationale: Fixes a bug where offline nodes overwrite anchors.dat with an empty list and drop anchor addresses, preserving eclipse attack mitigations across restarts. The PR ensures active block-relay connections are cached and not prematurely consumed when network activity is disabled, protecting an essential partition-resistance mechanism in P2P connection handling.
